title: Session evaluation
description: Two-field judgment of whether a product interaction achieved its stated objective. Produced by interact.evaluate_outcome.

goal_met.description: Whether the session demonstrated that the test objective was satisfied. True if the observed behavior is sufficient evidence; false otherwise.

headline.description: A one-line (roughly 10-15 word) summary of the outcome. Concrete and diff-able: 'Forward movement works; backward movement hangs.' or 'Startup crashes with AttributeError on GameEngine.__init__'. Used for comparing attempts across retry cycles.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing what was observed and why it does or does not satisfy the objective.

x-example.headline: Launched, accepted a command, printed expected greeting.
x-example.summary: Launched the program, entered a valid command, and observed the expected output. Goal satisfied.
